facts.interpretation: Strong persistence warns against a memoryless location state; a3by3 localGPSgrid misses ordinary transitions, and coarsecell residence is not physicalwaiting. Rare extremeGPS jumps cannot be represented as plausible roadmotion.

own_critical_assessment: The existing53766roadchain graph has variablelength edges, so its adjacency cannot substitute for one15second transition. Such a substitution would confuse roadhopcount with the targetduration.
A direction/history state or a semiMarkov travelclock would be required. Both increase inferencecost and must pass a bounded resourceprobe before population construction.
Measurementnoise should be represented in an auxiliary observationmodel, not converted into unrestricted physicalteleportation.
All original queries and durationtargets must remain. A GPS-quality mask for auxiliary supervision must not silently remove difficult primaryrows.
Exact forwardnormalization corrects a mathematical mechanism; it is not evidence that the resulting coarsegenerative model improves OD MAE.
